title: RN-7.0.1 Ledgerline ERP 7.0.1 Release Notes
summary: Release notes for Ledgerline ERP 7.0.1 maintenance release, introducing F2 rate history lookup in PUR-PO-01 and newest-first stock ledger sorting.
body:
Ledgerline ERP 7.0.1 is a maintenance release issued on 15 June 2015 for all Ledgerline 7 customers across the Manchester works and Leeds unit [^r1]. It introduces an F2 rate history lookup within purchase order entry to view past agreed unit prices from settled orders, as well as default newest-first ordering for stock ledger inquiries [^r2][^r3].

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Version | 7.0.1 [^r1] |
| Release date | 2015-06-15 [^r1] |
| Release type | Maintenance release [^r1] |
| Status | Current [^r1] |
| Deployment scope | Manchester works, Leeds unit [^r1] |

## Changes

Pressing F2 in the Rate field of [[screen-pur-po-01|screen PUR-PO-01]] invokes a rate history lookup that allows buyers to view earlier agreed unit prices from settled purchase orders [^r2]. If no prior purchase orders exist for the selected item and supplier combination when F2 is pressed, the system displays an informational message and leaves the cursor in the Rate field [^r4].

The stock ledger enquiry display defaults to sorting inventory movement records newest transactions first [^r3].

Known issues identified in the release include:
* Works order variance report column headings become misaligned on subsequent pages when run across several production batches [^r6].
* Part lookup on screen PUR-PO-01 exhibits delays when browsing large stock categories, which users can bypass by entering initial description characters [^r7].
* The stock ledger inquiry screen may show a newly received material's status as pending inspection until the window is closed and reopened, although stock balances update immediately [^r8].

## Effect at Northbridge

External integrations extracting stock ledger data must explicitly sort queries or payloads if they require chronological ascending order, because default query services return records sorted newest first [^r5].

## See also

* [[screen-pur-po-01|screen-pur-po-01: PUR-PO-01 Purchase Order Entry]]

r1.quote: Ledgerline ERP 7.0.1 was released on 15 June 2015. It is a maintenance release for all Ledgerline 7 customers.

r2.quote: When raising or amending purchase orders, buying staff can now press F2 within the unit rate entry field to call up a window detailing previous purchase rates agreed with suppliers

r3.quote: The stock ledger enquiry display has been adjusted so that movement records are sorted with the newest transactions shown first.

r4.section: Purchasing: Rate history on F2 in the Rate field of PUR-PO-01
r4.loc_text: p. 2, Purchasing: Rate history on F2 in the Rate field of PUR-PO-01
r4.quote: If no prior orders exist for that item and supplier combination, the system displays an information message and keeps the cursor in the field.

r5.section: Inventory: Stock ledger sorted newest first
r5.loc_text: p. 3, Inventory: Stock ledger sorted newest first
r5.quote: If a downstream routine, such as an external reporting utility or warehouse handheld sync, assumes an ascending order of posting lines, the receiving process must be adjusted to sort the payload explicitly

r6.quote: When generating the works order variance report across several production runs, column headings on subsequent pages can become misaligned.

r7.quote: The part lookup facility on the purchase order entry screen exhibits noticeable delay when querying stock categories with extensive component listings.

r8.quote: The stock balance updates correctly, but the display flag shows the delivery as pending inspection until the inquiry window is closed and reopened.
